SELECT 
  c.circuitId,
  c.name,
  COUNT(*) as race_count,
  ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races), 3) as share_percent,
  ROUND(COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) - 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT circuitId) FROM races), 6) as margin_above_avg
FROM races r
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
GROUP BY c.circuitId
HAVING COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) > 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT circuitId) FROM races)
ORDER BY margin_above_avg DESC
LIMIT 10
